function mountArchScene(canvas, roots, onPick, onLost?): ArchSceneHandle | null

Defined in: experiments/docs/arch-scene.ts:743

Dual-path mount — the scene3d (rust/WebGPU) engine takes the scene on capable hardware and the three.js arm remains the fallback for every other device, exactly like the widget migrations. Capability order: no webglAllowed() (explicit debug fallback / GL block) or no navigator.gpu → straight to the three path, which keeps its synchronous null contract. With WebGPU present the wasm arm mounts async; any failure resolves into the three arm inside the same handle (or onLost when GL is also absent).

Parameters

canvas

HTMLCanvasElement

Target canvas.

roots

object[]

Manifest root buckets.

onPick

(_path) => void

Called with the manifest path on a node pick.

onLost?

() => void

Called once when no GPU path can mount — the host hides the section (the three arm's own null return already covered the no-WebGPU case).

Returns

ArchSceneHandle | null

Scene handle, or null only when the synchronous three probe fails outright.
